description.value: Ocean Mist Guesthouse is a craftsman-style owner-operated property near the tip of the Ucluelet peninsula offering two self-contained private suites — the ground-floor Blue Heron Room and the second-storey Uncle John Room. Each suite features a kitchenette, private ensuite, covered cedar deck, and dedicated exterior entrance, making it well suited for a quiet, self-sufficient coastal stay. The property sits a five-minute walk from the Wild Pacific Trail Lighthouse Loop and roughly fifteen minutes from Pacific Rim National Park's Long Beach unit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and fully fetched. Contact details (address, phone) are confirmed from the contact subpage. No mention of bikes, bike storage, or cycling amenities anywhere on the site; breakfast is explicitly discontinued as of 2019. Device charging (USB/AC outlets) and Wi-Fi are confirmed from room feature listings, and nearby dining is referenced in general terms on the front page.
concerns: No phone number in OSM record; phone sourced from website contact page (primary: 1-250-726-7199, secondary: 1-250-726-5284, toll-free: 1-877-726-6478).
No cycling-specific amenities or bike storage mentioned anywhere on the website; required criteria are unverifiable from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The guesthouse is a legitimate accommodation near major cycling routes, but the website contains no mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities — the two required WWC criteria cannot be confirmed and must be verified directly with the hosts before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two-suite property; maximum two guests per room per Ucluelet By-Law No. 1310, 2022. Hosts live on-site and are described as readily available. Property has stairs (two sets: 4 steps and 8 steps) leading to the shared guest entrance, which may be relevant for loaded touring bikes.
